Q9029.reason: Water is hypotonic and can be absorbed through the bladder wall, causing electrolyte disturbance such as hyponatraemia, so sterile saline is used.

Q9030.reason: The son's rights had not vested through knowledge or reliance before the owner and landscaper modified the contract and the owner paid, so the modification is effective against him. Under Restatement (Second) of Contracts § 311, the modification defeats the son's claim.

Q9031.reason: Under UCC 2-210 and 9-406, a general bar on assignment does not stop assignment of the right to receive payment unless the contract says so specifically.
